choose.when: insert into wf_deploy_call_activity (deploy_id, process_key, element_id, version_policy, target_definition_id, target_process_key, target_process_name, target_version, target_deployment_id, inherit_variables, inherit_business_key, local_scope_for_output, propagation_policy, input_mappings_json, output_mappings_json, snapshot_checksum, create_by, create_time) values (#{item.deployId}, #{item.processKey}, #{item.elementId}, #{item.versionPolicy}, #{item.targetDefinitionId}, #{item.targetProcessKey}, #{item.targetProcessName}, #{item.targetVersion}, #{item.targetDeploymentId}, #{item.inheritVariables}, #{item.inheritBusinessKey}, #{item.localScopeForOutput}, #{item.propagationPolicy}, #{item.inputMappingsJson}, #{item.outputMappingsJson}, #{item.snapshotChecksum}, #{item.createBy}, current_timestamp(3))
choose.otherwise: insert into wf_deploy_call_activity (deploy_id, process_key, element_id, version_policy, target_definition_id, target_process_key, target_process_name, target_version, target_deployment_id, inherit_variables, inherit_business_key, local_scope_for_output, propagation_policy, input_mappings_json, output_mappings_json, snapshot_checksum, create_by, create_time) select '', '', '', 'FIXED', '', '', '', 1, '', false, false, false, 'CASCADE_ROOT', '[]', '[]', repeat('0', 64), '', current_timestamp(3) where 1 = 0

mapper.select: select snapshot_id, deploy_id, process_key, element_id, version_policy, target_definition_id, target_process_key, target_process_name, target_version, target_deployment_id, inherit_variables, inherit_business_key, local_scope_for_output, propagation_policy, input_mappings_json, output_mappings_json, snapshot_checksum, create_by, create_time from wf_deploy_call_activity where deploy_id = #{deployId} order by process_key, element_id
